title: Gable frame: assembled global stiffness coefficients (rotated members)

source.work: McGuire, W., Gallagher, R. H., Ziemian, R. D., Matrix Structural Analysis
source.notes: input data and targets read on the cited pages; nothing of the source is reproduced

analysis: Plane (x-y) problem of the source modelled in 3D with the global Y axis vertical, so that the source's x, y and theta_z are the model's X, Y and rz. In-plane bending is about local z for every member (default orientation), hence the source's I is the section's Iz. Gable frame, joints (m): a (0, 0), b (0, 5), c (sqrt 55, 8), d (sqrt 55 + 4, 5), e (sqrt 55 + 4, 0) - the source prints 7.416 m and 11.416 m for the 8 m rafter with a 3 m rise and the 5 m rafter with a 3 m drop. ab, cd, ed: A = 4e3 mm^2, I = 50e6 mm^4; bc: A = 6e3 mm^2, I = 200e6 mm^4; E = 200,000 MPa. The source assembles the stiffness matrix and solves nothing. A stiffness coefficient is obtained here as a reaction: every joint is fully held, one joint displacement (1 mm or 0.001 rad) is imposed per combination, and the reactions at that joint are the coefficients of the diagonal 3 x 3 block of that joint. First order, axial deformation included. Section properties the source does not give because they do not enter its plane model (Iy, J; A where stated) are placeholders that do not influence the targets.

quarantine.diagnosis: 16 of 18 stiffness coefficients reproduced. Missed: K(M_b, v_b) and K(M_c, v_c), by 1.4 times the tolerance: engine 200 x 17.3817 and 200 x (-7.7817), printed 17.381 and -7.781. Cause: a last-digit inconsistency in the source. Evidence: the coefficient is (6EI/L^2) cos(phi) = 18.75 x sqrt(55)/8 = 17.38171 (x 200); the source prints 17.381 in Example 5.3 and 17.382 for the same coefficient of the same member in Example 5.7 (p. 115). The engine's results for this model are confirmed by the other tiers that apply (tier C: OpenSeesPy and PyNite agree with the engine; tier D: equilibrium and the other invariants pass); the difference is between the source's printed digits and the exact solution of the stated problem.
